title: sources/<source>.yaml
description: One data source: its dialect, how to connect and which tables are in scope.

source.description: Source name. Equals the file name.

dialect.description: SQL dialect. Only duckdb and postgres run queries directly; the others use the query-plan protocol.

connection.description: How to connect. Never holds a URL or a secret.

env.description: Name of the variable holding the connection URL; never the URL itself. Read from the environment, else from an env file outside the semantic root.

env_prefix.description: Postgres only: the start of the variables holding the connection's parts, joined as written: PG reads PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE and PGSSLMODE; LAKE_ reads LAKE_HOST and so on. A source has env or env_prefix, not both.

database.description: DuckDB only: ":memory:" or a .duckdb file path relative to the semantic root.

setup.description: DuckDB only: statements run on every connection, in order. Each is one of an allowlist that semlayer validate checks and the DuckDB adapter enforces: LOAD or INSTALL of a named core extension, SET of a known safe setting, or CREATE SECRET from a provider chain or the environment, never literal keys.

views.description: DuckDB only: view name to relation, such as read_parquet('../data/x/*.parquet'). Each relation is a single table expression, a table function or a table name, with no subquery. Relative paths resolve from the semantic root.

intake.description: How the catalog reaches the layer and which schemas are read. Absent means mode connection with no schema limit.

mode.description: connection (the default when absent): the tools read the catalog through connection. export: the owner shared a catalog export because a connection was not possible.

reason.description: Export mode: why a connection was not possible, in the owner's words. semlayer validate warns when it is empty in export mode.

schemas.description: The only schemas read. A plain identifier; for BigQuery a dataset or project.dataset, for DuckDB an attached database's database.schema. semlayer validate errors on a duplicate and on a name that is not one, and warns on an empty list.

primary.description: The primary schema: the one schema a first layer reads and joins within. Absent, the primary is the only entry of schemas, or the only schema of the snapshot when schemas is absent or empty; with more than one, there is none. semlayer setup --primary writes it.

export.description: Export mode only: the catalog export the source was imported from.

file.description: Path of the export file, relative to the semantic root and inside it.

scope.description: Which tables are in scope. Exclude wins over include.

include.description: Patterns a table must match one of; empty or absent includes every table. Exact names and globs with * and ? (a dot matches schema.table, a "quoted" part matches exactly), or re:<regex> (at most 512 characters, checked for slow matching); see spec.md Scope patterns.

exclude.description: Patterns that remove a table from scope.

exclude_reasons.description:
Why an exclude pattern leaves tables out, by pattern, in the owner's words; semlayer scope --exclude

--reason --write records it and semlayer scope --explain shows it.

tables_file.description: A table-list file, relative to the semantic root (usually scope/<source>.txt): one pattern per line, !<pattern> to exclude, # comments. Its entries join include and exclude; see spec.md Table-list files.

sample_rows.description: Profile over a sample of this many rows when a table is larger; omit for full scans.

top_values.description: How many most frequent values to keep per column.

draft.description: Settings semlayer draft remembers for this source.

strip_prefixes.description: Prefixes removed from table names to form model names, such as fct_ and dim_.

calendar.description: How the source's calendar counts time (spec.md, Metric semantics). semlayer setup --week-start writes it.

week_start.description: The day a week starts, for every week grain of the source's time dimensions. Unset, a week starts on Monday. Setting or changing it changes the approval hash of each dimension with a week grain.

cross_schema.description: Schema pairs a join may cross (spec.md Schema scope, Schema pairs). Each runs from the schema holding the foreign key to the schema it references and lists the keys that connect them; a join between tables of the two schemas, either way, is allowed only on an approved pair's keys. A declined pair records the owner's no. semlayer add-cross-schema writes an entry and semlayer remove-cross-schema removes one.

from.description: The schema holding the foreign key.

status.description: draft: recorded, not yet approved; approved: semlayer approve set it on the owner's yes; declined: the owner said the layer does not join these schemas.

keys.description: The key relationships: at least one unless the pair is declined.

from.description: <table>.<column> of a table in the from schema.

to.description: <table>.<column> of a table in the to schema.

constraint.description: The foreign key constraint the key came from, as the snapshot names it.

reply.description: Declined pairs: the owner's words, as recorded.

declined_at.description: Declined pairs: the date of the owner's no, YYYY-MM-DD.

approved_by.description: Who approved it. Required when status is approved.

approved_at.description: ISO date of approval, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when status is approved.

approved_hash.description: Written by semlayer approve: the hash of the pair when it was approved.
